contentFindings: The current canonical target is an LK Q1 explanation of CRISPR/Cas mechanism and application. The Hessian 2024 Q1.4 source lists the CRISPR/Cas method at elevated level; the cases remain within a method-and-application explanation and require no learner wet-lab work or therapeutic success claim.

The profile correctly assigns sequence recognition to the guide RNA/PAM-compatible Cas9 complex and double-strand cleavage to Cas9. It distinguishes cleavage from cellular repair, possible indels or template-dependent precise change, and outcome verification. Its German and English expectations and both cases agree.

The independent cases differ substantively: a plant-cell research knockout with measured indels versus an intended precise base correction with a repair template and partial sequencing success. Neither case treats a cut as proof that all cells were edited or that a specified change occurred.

The actual active comic PNG shows labelled Cas9, guide RNA, DNA, adjacent PAM and a double-strand break. The 680/360 previews remain clear. Its alt text correctly limits the image to cleavage and disclaims repair or guaranteed editing.
scopeLimit: P and image-context candidate review only; the historical Q1 D review, formal V ledger, central registry and human gates are separate.
